children: Manhattan Bridge Capital increased its share buyback authorization from 250,000 to 500,000 common shares.
The board approved doubling the aggregate number of shares authorized for repurchase under the existing program.
Repurchases may occur through open-market transactions, privately negotiated transactions or other means.
The program does not require the company to repurchase shares, and the board may change or terminate the authorization.
The program’s October 9, 2027 expiration date and all other terms remain unchanged.
